references.text: The promise to share the good land with those who follow the people of Israel, as the Lord promised.
The descendants of Hobab the Kenite received a portion in the land together with the tribe of Judah, fulfilling the promise given here.
God's promise of blessing to Abraham and those who join his people.
Rahab asks for kindness toward her family, similar to the promise Moses gives to Hobab.
The context where Moses invites Hobab to come along and promises him a share in the blessings.
David promises to do good, a similar pledge to share the Lord's blessings.
